nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the privileged admin account used as the access-control anchor for onlyAdmin.
Public uint state variable holding pause flags; written by constructor, adminPause and read by the pausable modifier.
Public address state variable of NearProver holding the trusted bridge contract address.
Constructor of AdminControlled that initialises admin and paused from its arguments.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == admin; guards all privileged admin functions.
Modifier requiring the given flag to be unpaused or the caller to be admin; reads paused and msg.sender.
onlyAdmin function that overwrites the paused flags with the supplied value.
onlyAdmin function performing an arbitrary assembly sstore(key, value).
onlyAdmin function performing masked assembly sload/sstore to selectively update storage bits.
onlyAdmin function transferring ETH to an arbitrary destination via transfer.
onlyAdmin payable function accepting ETH without further logic.
onlyAdmin payable function delegating execution to an arbitrary target and returning raw data.
Constructor of NearProver that sets bridge and invokes the AdminControlled base constructor.
Caller address used for admin authentication in onlyAdmin and for bypassing pause flags in pausable.
Low-level assembly sstore writing an arbitrary storage slot and value.
Masked assembly sload/xor/and/sstore that rewrites storage bits at an arbitrary key.
External ETH transfer to an arbitrary payable destination, sending funds from the contract balance.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-influenced target, executing foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Constructor parameter _admin assigned to the admin state variable.
Constructor parameter flags assigned to the paused state variable.
Parameter flag of the pausable modifier used to test the paused bitmask.
Parameter flags of adminPause written directly into the paused state variable.
Storage slot key parameter consumed by the assembly sstore in adminSstore.
Value parameter written into storage by the assembly sstore in adminSstore.
Storage slot key parameter used by the masked assembly sload/sstore.
Value parameter masked and written by the assembly in adminSstoreWithMask.
Bitmask parameter controlling which storage bits are updated.
Payable destination address of the ETH transfer in adminSendEth.
Amount of wei transferred by adminSendEth.
Target contract address called via delegatecall in adminDelegatecall.
Calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Constructor parameter _bridge assigned to the bridge state variable.
Constructor parameter _admin of NearProver forwarded to the AdminControlled base constructor.
Constructor parameter _pausedFlags of NearProver forwarded to the AdminControlled base constructor.
Boolean returned by the delegatecall low-level call and checked by require.
Bytes returned by the delegatecall and forwarded as the function return value.
Assembly local holding the pre-update sload result in adminSstoreWithMask.

edges.reason: onlyAdmin compares the untrusted msg.sender against the admin state variable to grant privileges.
pausable allows the untrusted msg.sender equal to admin to bypass the pause flag check.
onlyAdmin reads the admin state variable for the equality check with msg.sender.
pausable reads the paused state variable to test the pause bitmask.
adminPause is gated by the onlyAdmin modifier.
adminSstore is gated by the onlyAdmin modifier before performing raw sstore.
adminSstoreWithMask is gated by the onlyAdmin modifier before masked storage writes.
adminSendEth is gated by the onlyAdmin modifier before transferring ETH.
adminReceiveEth is gated by the onlyAdmin modifier for receiving ETH.
adminDelegatecall is gated by the onlyAdmin modifier before executing arbitrary delegatecall.
AdminControlled constructor writes the admin state variable.
AdminControlled constructor writes the paused state variable.
Constructor parameter _admin is assigned to the admin state variable.
Constructor parameter flags is assigned to the paused state variable.
adminPause parameter flags is written into the paused state variable.
adminPause mutates the paused state variable.
Parameter key flows into the assembly sstore storage slot.
Parameter value flows into the assembly sstore stored value.
Parameter key selects the storage slot read and written by the masked assembly.
Parameter value is xored and masked before being stored.
Parameter mask controls which bits of the stored value are updated.
Assembly local oldval from sload is combined with the masked value before sstore.
Parameter destination is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
Parameter amount is the wei value sent by transfer.
Parameter target is the contract address delegated to.
Parameter data is the calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
adminSstore executes the inline assembly sstore operation.
adminSstoreWithMask executes the masked assembly sload/sstore block.
adminSendEth performs the external ETH transfer.
adminDelegatecall performs the arbitrary delegatecall, only mitigated by the onlyAdmin check.
NearProver constructor parameter _bridge is assigned to the bridge state variable.
NearProver constructor invokes the AdminControlled base constructor.
NearProver parameter _admin is forwarded to the base constructor.
NearProver parameter _pausedFlags is forwarded to the base constructor.
Local success from the delegatecall is consumed by require in adminDelegatecall.
Local rdata from the delegatecall is returned by adminDelegatecall.
